description:
Welcome to Old School Electrical — a place where Electrical Engineering is taught the classic way.

In a world of fast slides and memorized formulas, this channel returns to traditional engineering teaching, where concepts are carefully explained step-by-step so that students can truly understand, think, and apply what they learn.

Using chalkboard lessons, complex topics in Electrical Engineering, Circuit Analysis, Network Theory, Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Control Systems, and Engineering Fundamentals are broken down into clear and logical explanations that are easy to follow.

This channel is built on a simple philosophy:

Engineering is not about memorizing facts — it is about understanding principles so the mind can think, analyze, and solve real problems.

If you are a Electrical Engineering student, diploma student, competitive exam aspirant, or someone who wants strong engineering fundamentals, these lessons will help you build a deep understanding of the subject.
